main.description: Index entry in community repo pointing to a user's personal group post. The `post` field is a strongRef (uri + cid) so readers can verify integrity.

post.description: StrongRef (uri + cid) of the post in the author's personal repo.

listItemUri.description: Optional list item reference for filtering.

parentPostUri.description: Optional parent post reference for threading.

deletedByAdmin.description: True if admin has marked this post as deleted (moderation).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the post was created.
